front_door.description: Access appears via a small white timber pedestrian gate set in a tall white timber fence; the gate is marked “61b.” The actual dwelling door is set back inside and not visible from the pavement.

access_notes: Corner/end plot at a road junction
Tall white timber fence enclosing side garden along Salford Road
Vegetation/hedge overhanging near the gate line
Parking zone sign pole on pavement immediately by the gate
Pavement level access; no external steps visible from street
No hydrant marker or standpipe observed
rear_access_note: Side gate off Salford Road leads into side garden which appears to provide a route toward the rear; no separate rear alley visible.
parking: Kerbside parking bays on Salford Road directly outside the property; additional kerbside space on the cross street at the junction.
